# Third-party licensing

This repository contains vendored and pinned third-party source. Its copyright notices and license texts remain with each component; the root AGPL-3.0-only license applies to CloudMount-authored source and does not replace those third-party terms.

## Cryptomator cryptolib-swift

The vendored source is pinned in `upstream.json`. The upstream project publishes AGPLv3 for FOSS projects and offers a separate commercial license for independent software vendors and resellers. This repository follows the upstream AGPLv3 FOSS route for the combined CloudMount source. No commercial license is included or claimed.

## Recovery wordlist

The pinned Cryptomator desktop recovery wordlist retains its GPLv3 notice in `CRYPTOMATOR-DESKTOP-LICENSE.txt`.

## Other dependencies

See the license files and notices under `Vendor/`, `Mobile/Resources/Licenses/`, `Engine/` and `Resources/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`. Review each dependency's terms before redistributing a modified build. Cryptolib source is retained under its upstream license; no Cryptomator affiliation is implied.

The source license selection does not state that Apple's EULA or App Store distribution terms have been reviewed or accepted as AGPL-compatible.
